name: splatcraft
description: Pure-Rust Gaussian splat toolkit: inspect, convert, edit, merge, render, Marble world generation and video-to-splat training.

tools.name: splat_inspect
tools.description: Count, bounds, SH degree and stats of a PLY or SPZ splat file.

tools.name: splat_edit
tools.description: Ordered crop, prune, transform and reduce_sh pipeline.

tools.name: splat_render
tools.description: Headless GPU PNG render of a splat file.

tools.name: splat_worlds
tools.description: World Labs Marble client with a spend ledger; generate is a dry run unless confirmed.

tools.name: splat_train
tools.description: Video, images or COLMAP dataset to splat via ffmpeg, COLMAP and Brush.

tools.name: splat_engine_status
tools.description: Report which external engines are available.

tools.name: splat_synth
tools.description: Generate labelled synthetic splat data for testing.
